scope: Released slab constructor values, exact activated minion classes, selected spawning/sacrifice/ownership/resource methods and recipe definitions; no game execution.
limits: A lifespan argument of -1 disables this base-class age cutoff; it does not certify persistence or immortality.
Spawn return values and item/resource ordering must be checked separately.
Creation cost and sacrifice XP are different values and different actions.
Recipe definitions are not proof of all ingredient acquisition routes.
Portraits preserve their existing cross-version provenance.
